description:
Validate an Avro schema against the Apache Avro 1.11 specification: names, unions, defaults, enums and fixed sizes, each fault reported at its path. Optionally check a datum (in plain JSON form) against the schema too.

Returns: JSON { valid, type?, errors[], datum?{ valid, errors[], warnings[] } }.
Example input: {"text":"{\"type\":\"record\",\"name\":\"User\",\"fields\":[{\"name\":\"id\",\"type\":\"long\"}]}"}
On error, includes hint: The schema must be JSON. A datum is given in plain JSON form: a union value directly, not wrapped like Avro's JSON encoding.

datum.description: A value to validate against the schema, as plain JSON (a union value given directly, not wrapped).

name: avro_check
title: Check an Avro schema
